The game explicitly stated I can "inate, pante and eness," which likely correspond to "in," "pan," and "en" (or similar short commands). I should have immediately tested these specific, short-action verbs instead of guessing long phrases. My new plan is to use only the valid, short-action verbs provided in the instructions (e.g., "in", "pan", "en", "go", "take", "put") to interact with objects and move between rooms, avoiding any descriptive or multi-word commands.
